about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Trades-first bank lesson 2 ('Lead with the monthly payment', video/studio/research/runs/2026-10-28-trades-insights.md). The ACHR News page was re-read with WebFetch on Oct 29, 2026 (America/Chicago), and only what it says is used.

acca.title: Survey Reveals Strategies to Boost HVAC Close Rates by Double Digits
acca.publisher: ACHR News (author Chris Gray), reporting the Air Conditioning Contractors of America (ACCA) and Farmington Consulting Group 'Contractor of the Future' survey
acca.method: A survey conducted by ACCA and Farmington Consulting Group of more than 1,000 contractors nationwide (ACCA's own write-up: more than 1,000 HVACR contractors)
acca.overallLeadQuote: most contractors (72%) tend to lead with the overall price of the job.
acca.financedQuote: Contractors leading with a monthly payment option see 42% of their new or replacement system sales financed compared to 21% when using the overall price.
acca.entryQuote: (leading with a monthly payment also lowers the entry-level equipment mix) dropping it to 34% versus 42% when leading with the overall price.
acca.everyJobQuote: However, only 37% are offering it on every job.
acca.closeQuote: The average close rate is 38% when contractors don't offer financing. When they do, that average rises to 49%. (caption context only, not said)
acca.scope: A survey of contractors: shares among the surveyed contractors, correlation, not cause. Said 'contractors who lead with', never 'this makes'. The 42% and 21% are shares of new or replacement system sales that were financed (said 'system sales'). The 34% and 42% are the entry-level equipment mix (said 'entry-level systems, percent of sales'). The 37% is said 'in that survey, only thirty-seven percent offer it on every job', with no wider base. The close rates are caption only.
